Substitution, Stoke City. Sam Gallagher replaces Million Manhoef.
Substitution, Stoke City. Luca Bombino replaces Ben Wilmot.
Substitution, Norwich City. Anthony Musaba replaces Anis Ben Slimane.
Bosun Lawal (Stoke City) is shown the yellow card.
Ethan Galbraith (Stoke City) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
